name: FX_Atomic

textures.channels: RGB straight colour (sRGB) + alpha; 8 x 4 frames of 512 px, row by row from the top left

flipbook.ground_line: the sprite's ground point is 5 % of the frame above its bottom edge; side view at 18 degrees

source_note: frames are computed by the build script (seeded, deterministic): numpy fields -> OpenVDB -> Cycles volume render; no .blend is kept
dresses: fire burst 161, 1.3 s: a mound of fire, a stem climbing to 3 m with a cap rolling over it, the collapse into a wide burning mass and grey smoke
known_weaknesses: Analytic shapes and noise: the cap does not roll as a real thermal does. No light on the scene. A flipbook on a camera-facing card: it has no depth against the scene and casts no light.
